# Ralskies
> Filipino remote male vocalist and musical theatre singer offering lead vocals, character singing, harmonies, duets and collaboration projects.

Official booking page: https://ralskies.vercel.app/hire/
Machine-readable service catalog: https://ralskies.vercel.app/vocal-services.json
Website: https://ralskies.vercel.app/
Email: ralskiesartist@gmail.com

## Work categories
- Remote lead vocals for original music, demos, pop and emotional ballads
- Character vocals and musical theatre singing for animation, indie games and songs
- Harmony arrangement, backing vocals and vocal doubles
- Collaborative covers, duets, and original songwriting partnerships

## Important
Rates and availability are negotiated for each project. No automated booking, payment or guarantees. Rights, revisions, usage and credit must be agreed before work begins. Demo material on YouTube may include covers with third-party rights.
